_note: v2 hooks for le Passage de la Brocante (ST_brocante, S03_market), an autumn flea-market passage full of falling golden leaves and bric-a-brac, the share-store-money street (ST_commerce seg005-008). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; beret color = verb group.

fr_negocier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe NEGOTIATES with the old stallholder over the brass gramophone: nay-GO-SEE-ay! (nay-goh-SYAY).
fr_negocier_verb.why: NEGOTIATE → négocier = to negotiate (négocier le prix). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (nay-go-SYAY -> nay-goh-SYAY).

fr_combler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe FILLS the basket to the brim with COMBS: COMB-LAY! (kohn-BLAY).
fr_combler_verb.why: COMB → combler = to fill (a gap), to fulfill (combler un vide). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (kohm-BLAY -> kohn-BLAY).

fr_decreter_verb.hook: Standing on a CRATE, Monsieur Verbe DECREES with a blank scroll: DE-CRATE-ay! (day-kray-TAY).
fr_decreter_verb.why: DECREE + CRATE → décréter = to decree, to order (décréter une fête). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_distribuer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe DISTRIBUTES red apples, one to each child (dees-tree-bew-AY).
fr_distribuer_verb.why: DISTRIBUTE → distribuer = to hand out, to distribute (distribuer des pommes). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_repartir_verb_2.hook: Monsieur Verbe shares out paper party hats in little piles: a RE-PARTY! (ray-pahr-TEER).
fr_repartir_verb_2.why: RE-PARTY → répartir = to share out, to divide up (répartir les chapeaux). GREEN beret = regular -ir. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ray-par-TEER -> ray-pahr-TEER).

fr_entreposer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ENTERS the warehouse with an armchair and strikes a POSE: ENTER-POSE! He STORES it (ahn-truh-poh-ZAY).
fr_entreposer_verb.why: ENTER + POSE → entreposer = to store (in a warehouse) (entreposer des meubles). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ahn-truh-po-ZAY -> ahn-truh-poh-ZAY).

fr_demarquer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe peels the MARK off the big blue vase: DE-MARK! (day-mahr-KAY).
fr_demarquer_verb.why: DE-MARK → démarquer = to remove the mark or label from (démarquer un vase). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (day-mar-KAY -> day-mahr-KAY).

fr_allouer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ALLOTS one loaf each: only one ALLOWED per child! (a-loo-AY).
fr_allouer_verb.why: ALLOW → allouer = to allot, to allocate (allouer un pain à chacun). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_miner_verb.hook: With a MINER's lamp over his beret, Monsieur Verbe MINES the heap of coal (mee-NAY).
fr_miner_verb.why: MINER → miner = to mine; to undermine (miner le charbon). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_subventionner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe drops coins into the toy SUBmarine: he SUBSIDIZES the little girl's stall (sewb-vahn-syoh-NAY).
fr_subventionner_verb.why: SUB + SUBVENTION → subventionner = to subsidize (subventionner un stand). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (sewb-vahn-syo-NAY -> sewb-vahn-syoh-NAY).

fr_liquider_verb.hook: Clearance sale! Monsieur Verbe pours away every LIQUID: he LIQUIDATES his stock (lee-kee-DAY).
fr_liquider_verb.why: LIQUID / LIQUIDATE → liquider = to sell off, to settle, to liquidate (liquider le stock). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_monnayer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe blows his trumpet and out pour gold coins: MONEY-YAY! He MINTS money (moh-nay-YAY).
fr_monnayer_verb.why: MONEY-YAY → monnayer = to mint (coins), to cash in (monnayer son talent). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (mo-neh-YAY -> moh-nay-YAY).

fr_cumuler_verb.hook: Under the big CUMULUS clouds, Monsieur Verbe piles up three hats at once (kew-mew-LAY).
fr_cumuler_verb.why: CUMULUS → cumuler = to pile up, to hold several at once (cumuler les emplois). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_taxer_verb.hook: From his little TAXI, Monsieur Verbe holds out his tin to TAX every passer-by (tak-SAY).
fr_taxer_verb.why: TAXI / TAX → taxer = to tax (taxer les passants). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_surcharger_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pushes a cart OVERLOADED sky-high: SUPER-CHARGE! (sewr-shahr-ZHAY).
fr_surcharger_verb.why: SUR + CHARGE → surcharger = to overload; to overcharge (surcharger la charrette). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (sewr-shar-ZHAY -> sewr-shahr-ZHAY).

fr_recharger_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe cranks the old lantern to RECHARGE it until it glows (ruh-shahr-ZHAY).
fr_recharger_verb.why: RECHARGE → recharger = to recharge, to reload (recharger la lanterne). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ruh-shar-ZHAY -> ruh-shahr-ZHAY).

fr_enraciner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ROOTS a sapling in a silver RACING trophy: en-RACING-ay! (ahn-rah-see-NAY).
fr_enraciner_verb.why: RACING / racine (root) → enraciner = to root, to make take root (enraciner un arbre). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ahn-ra-see-NAY -> ahn-rah-see-NAY).

fr_acquitter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PAYS for his tea with a coin and a KEY: A KEY-TEA! (a-kee-TAY).
fr_acquitter_verb.why: A KEY + TEA → acquitter = to pay, to settle (acquitter la note). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_deposseder_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe lifts the golden crown off the mannequin: DISPOSSESSED! (day-po-say-DAY).
fr_deposseder_verb.why: DISPOSSESS → déposséder = to dispossess (déposséder le roi de sa couronne). RED beret = regular -er.
